DEFENDANT JETBLUE AIRWAYS, REPRESENTED BY MARK SCHLOSSER IS PRESENT VIA UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM APPEARANCE. THE COURT DID NOT RECEIVE DEFENDANT'S ZOOM REQUEST AT THE TIME OF THE HEARING. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
